hypothesis: Corresponding pretrained FFN matrices have a small shared depth subspace, and a smooth depth curve retains it without recovery training.
primary_comparator: Unchanged pretrained TinyLlama; centered PCA plus constant is the non-smooth matched-matrix-count control.
primary_metric: Validation mean next-token cross-entropy in nats per TinyLlama token at 128-token reset context; secondary full-vocabulary forward KL and teacher top-1 agreement.
minimum_useful_effect: At K=8, <=0.10 nats/token CE increase vs teacher and <=0.05 nats/token spline disadvantage vs PCA. These are exploratory continuation thresholds, not statistical confirmation.
success_rule: Both K=8 thresholds must hold. Structure-only success cannot satisfy the functional gate.
futility_rule: Stop on failed identity/finite checks, more than 30 minutes execution, or memory pressure. Retain every declared outcome; no selection by validation to omit failed arms.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-16 America/Denver: "go ahead with the experiments, lets explore" following the proposed TinyLlama FFN-only depth-curve comparison; prior instruction directs PRs to JRowe47/Super-1.
authorization.approved_resources: Bounded local CPU exploratory measurements using existing workspace; no paid compute, GPU, large training, or official test.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: 4 threads, at most 120 aggregate CPU minutes

design.mechanism_equations: For each FFN tensor family X[L,P], Gram G=X X^T; fitted weights Xhat=Q Q^T X. PCA: constant + top K-1 eigenvectors of centered G. Spline: uniform clamped cubic B-spline column space, K controls. Cosine: first K DCT-II modes. Evaluate full pretrained model after replacing only FFN weights.
design.control_rationale: Same K full dense matrices per tensor role; PCA coefficients unrestricted across layers, spline/cosine depth spaces fixed. Rank22 roundtrip validates implementation. 64 shuffled-depth controls assess natural-order structure without model retraining.
design.seed_selection_method: Fixed seed for arm order and depth permutations; one fixed pretrained checkpoint, no training seeds.
design.parameter_counts: Computed exactly from checkpoint shapes. K*3*5632*2048 basis scalars, plus PCA coefficient metadata and unchanged non-FFN parameters.
design.matching_track: Full matrix basis storage count, not FLOP or quality matching; reconstruction is materialized for functional checks.
design.compute_accounting: Per-stage and per-arm wall/process CPU time; maximum process RSS. These timings are not deployment-speed benchmarks.

data.confirmation_sha256: Not applicable: exploratory validation only; no independent confirmation dataset
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: Official validation has been used in earlier project work; prior tokenizer and sample boundaries differ. Not an untouched confirmation set. Pretraining contamination not audited.
data.teacher_and_objective: Public TinyLlama 1.1B 3T base checkpoint; no OpenAI model outputs used as training data; no gradient training in this pass.

training.state_carry_and_detach: KV cache disabled; reset each window
training.document_reset_policy: Fixed windows on concatenated split lines; may cross article boundaries; no cross-window state
training.optimizer_schedule: No optimizer; exact weight-space least squares
training.precision: FP64 depth Gram/basis; FP32 reconstruction and model evaluation
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: All declared arms, no best-checkpoint selection

execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: New isolated branch/run in current Linux workspace; prior macOS SSD instructions apply to the old host. Current user-authorized cloud workspace is used; no old run modified.
execution.canary_matrix: Independent small-array projection/error algebra; full-rank fit identity; official HF teacher repeated; full model spline22 reconstruction against teacher.
execution.cost_estimate: 4.4GB public checkpoint; 4 CPU threads; aim 10-25 minutes measurements, hard measurement deadline 30 minutes; no paid compute

evaluation.primary_endpoint: 16 fixed validation windows x 128 targets = 2048 targets; all token positions scored
evaluation.duplicate_policy: Teacher first window repeated; spline22 full-validation roundtrip; recompute derived aggregates from per-window values
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Descriptive per-window CE changes and standard error over 16 windows; no independence or population-level guarantee
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: All 9 arms published; K8 gate fixed in advance, no formal superiority significance claim
evaluation.local_ffn_diagnostic: Teacher-normalized FFN inputs and output captures for first training and first validation windows; relative squared FFN output error over all 22 layers. These are diagnostics, no fitting to validation activations.

deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: Not measured: functional teacher-forced evaluation only
deployment.memory_components: Analytical compact basis storage counted; execution materializes all 22 layers and is not a compact inference runtime

evidence.protocol_sha256: Stored in REGISTRATION.json to avoid self-reference
evidence.preservation_policy: Commit source, protocols, small exact results and charts to user fork; external checkpoint/data remain recoverable from pinned revisions and SHA256. Transformed weights deterministically regenerate from input and saved small projectors.

decision.next_experiment: Determined from this screen; no follow-up launch implied
